text:
elaine: Quick FYI — I'm about to start the large docs move that renames /reference -> /platform/reference and splits some SDK snippets into a new snippets/ folder. It's going to be 4 PRs (one per major section). Need to coordinate reviewers and merge windows.
ben: thanks — timeline? I can review the SDK snippets PRs but won't be available after 11:30 PT today.
sam: I can do two of the content PRs (auth and routing) but prefer merges after CI previews are stable. what's the plan for redirects and anchors?
elaine: plan: PR A = move reference pages + redirects; PR B = snippets extract; PR C = update TOCs & cross-links; PR D = anchor fixes + redirect test harness. We'll open them in that order but might merge B earlier if tidy.
marta: @elaine do we have automated redirect generation? last time we had a few broken anchors after the move.
elaine: yes, there's a script: tools/docs/redirect-gen.sh — it emits a _redirects file and a redirect-map.json. But manual check needed for anchors. I'll attach the script in PR A.
ben: can you paste the redirect rule pattern so I can skim? small snippet ok.
elaine: ````
# redirect-gen example
old_path=/docs/reference/auth
new_path=/docs/platform/reference/auth
# output: /docs/reference/auth -> /docs/platform/reference/auth 301
````
sam: CI preview will show 404s if anchors don't match. We should run the link-checker job locally and in the PR. use: `make link-check`.
marta: got it. Who's approving each PR? I'd like at least two approvals for PR A and C.
elaine: suggested reviewers: PR A — sam + ben; PR B — ben + marta; PR C — sam + elaine (because I touched TOCs); PR D — marta + ben. Open to swaps.
ben: I can do A or B today before 11:30. After that, only B (tomorrow) unless urgent.
sam: I'll take A and C. I prefer to merge A during the 1-hour merge window (11:00-12:00 PT) to limit site churn. If A goes first, previews for B/C/D should be stable.
marta: can we stagger merges across two days? A + B day 1, C + D day 2? Less chance of cascade failures.
elaine: that works. I'll open all PRs now but mark B/C/D as "do not merge" until we confirm A is green.
ci-bot: PR A preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-123--docs.redwood.example.com (checks running)
ben: preview link looks good at a glance :eyes:
sam: running `make link-check` locally now — found 3 anchor mismatches, I'll post them.
sam: mismatch 1: /reference/auth#oauth -> new anchor is #oauth-flow (in auth.md)
sam: mismatch 2: /reference/sdk#init -> new anchor #sdk-initialize (snippets moved)
sam: mismatch 3: internal TOC entry referencing /reference/routing#redirects (now /platform/reference/routing#redirects)
marta: those are easy fixes in PR D or PR C? where do you want them applied?
sam: I'd prefer PR D to contain anchor normalization and tests; PR C updates TOCs to point at new paths. But we can hotfix anchors in A if it's blocking.
elaine: leaning to keep A only for file moves + redirects. We can patch obvious anchors in A if they are causing 404s on critical pages. Otherwise, let D handle normalization and tests.
ben: agree. If CI shows >10 broken links then we hold A. If it's a few anchors we can fix in A quickly.
marta: approval process — I'll review PR A after CI passes. @ben and @sam please flag when you've finished local checks.
ben: starting full local link check now. ETA 25m.
sam: done with checks, posted fixes in a gist: https://gist.example.com/sam/docs-anchor-fixes
elaine: thanks — I'll incorporate sam's small anchor patches into PR D and leave A minimal.
ci-bot: PR A checks: link-check FAILED (3 errors). See logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/789
sam: that's the three mismatches I listed.
elaine: ok I'll push a tiny patch to PR A to add redirects for the 3 anchors using the redirect-map hack (so old anchor URLs still resolve). then re-run CI.
ben: :thumbsup:
ci-bot: PR A re-run: link-check PASSED, html-validate PASSED, visual-diff QUEUED.
marta: looks good. Ben and Sam, can you both approve PR A when you get a sec? I can merge after both approvals and visual diffs green.
ben: approved.
sam: approved.
marta: merging now in the 11:00-12:00 PT window.
ci-bot: PR A merged by marta. Deploy started: https://deploy.redwood.example.com/sha/ab12
elaine: great — I'll unmark B/C/D from DNM and we can get the rest through tomorrow.
ben: I'll pick up PR B review tomorrow morning.
sam: I'll do a sweep after the production deploy is healthy.
elaine: thanks everyone — I'll add a short migration note in the release notes about the renamed paths and how to handle redirects for external links.
marta: nice job coordinating. :shipit:
elaine: closing the loop — files moved, redirects in place, anchored issue handled. will follow up if any more breakage shows in Sentry.
ci-bot: deploy complete: status=success, env=prod, url=https://docs.redwood.example.com\"
